verdict.rationale: You can pull data out programmatically: NerdGraph, a GraphQL API, queries New Relic data. NRQL can be run from the CLI ('nr1 nrql', fetching data from a laptop or CI) with JSON, Text or YAML output. OpenTelemetry instrumentation is platform-agnostic, which makes switching vendors easier. However, nothing shows a bulk or complete export of all account data (telemetry, dashboards, alerts) or a documented exit path, so it amounts to query-by-query extraction. Missing for 10: bulk/full-account data export, export of configuration assets in open formats, documented migration/offboarding path, independent corroboration of exporting and leaving.
